label: P3 v2 E2 observed-rate pilot (10 seeds)
method: Automated proxy for the visual Welch method: smallest job index after which the moving-average trajectory stays within 5% of the mean of the last 20% of jobs. This is a heuristic stand-in for eyeballing the plot, not a validated Welch procedure; `welch_plot.png` must be inspected by a human before the warm-up estimate is frozen in a run manifest.
